title: Fix preservation of center of mass in Langevin dynamics.
body:
The current implementation is incorrect, it almost fixes the center
of mass but a slight drift still appears.  The correct solution is not
to force the COM to remain the same, but ensure that the random arrays
do not add to the position or velocity of the center-of-mass.

Closes #977.
author: schiotz
